title: GraphUpdate
description: One worker's proposed write to a shared knowledge graph (notes/12). Validated before commit; every node and edge carries provenance so it can be audited and rolled back.

run_id.description: Execution that produced this update (matches tracing run_id, notes/08).

id.description: Mention-level ID. Resolution to a canonical entity happens later via RESOLVES_TO edges, never by overwriting this.

type.description: Must be a label in the ontology, e.g. Person, Organization, Claim.

description.description: Context used by resolution to avoid merging same-name entities.

type.description: Typed relationship from the ontology. ALIAS_OF / RESOLVES_TO are resolution edges and keep merges reversible.

evidence.description: Why this edge exists; required in practice for ALIAS_OF / RESOLVES_TO.

sources.description: Provenance. An update with an unsourced fact is rejected.

start.description: Character offset, computed deterministically (notes/10), not by the LLM.
